name: slack-notify
description: Posts to a Slack incoming webhook when Claude Code needs your input. Sends the project name and a short status only. Does nothing until you set a webhook URL.

slackWebhookUrl.title: Slack webhook URL
slackWebhookUrl.description: A Slack incoming webhook URL (https://hooks.slack.com/...). Anyone who has it can post to your channel. Empty means nothing is sent.
